categories.label: Memory
categories.meaning: Waiting for memory: a grant to sort or hash before a query can start (RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE), or an allocation inside the server (CMEMTHREAD, MEMORY_ALLOCATION_EXT). Grant waits usually mean a few queries reserve far more than they use; allocation waits mean many sessions contend for one of the server's memory objects.
